payload.prompt: Create a clear image containing exactly five plastic mushrooms and exactly seven spotted trucks. Make the five plastic mushrooms distinct, fully visible, separate from one another, and clearly molded from plastic. Make the seven trucks distinct, fully visible, separate from one another, non-overlapping, and easy to count one by one; every truck must clearly have visible spots. Do not include any additional mushrooms or trucks.
